headline:
تحديث Stardew Valley
الأكبر على الإطلاق
label: تقرير
credits: المصدر: الفيديو الرسمي للعبة على Steam
note: reel_check (newsroom/reel-check.md not released; same items here). Story type: QUOTE, labelled تقرير (single outlet, developer's own words at a concert). Hook: the biggest Stardew Valley update ever is coming. Why now: Eric Barone (ConcernedApe) spoke at the Symphony of Seasons concert in Colorado; GamesRadar quote 'We're working on the 1.7 update, which is looking to be the largest Stardew Valley update ever' and 'it'll probably come out sometime next year'; Denfaminico Gamer relayed it 4 Nov. Players here: PC and console farmers, no platforms or date stated; Clint and Sandy only 'the tip of the iceberg' (not used on screen). Payoff: 2027, probably, no official date (his own X post: no release date, no estimate). Footage route: Steam app 413150 first official trailer, fetched by the runner; the container cannot preview Steam, so shots are one contiguous stretch from 10 s judged on the render sheet. Sound: the trailer's own music, no speech. Picture: crop judged on the sheet; credit on all shots; chip تقرير. Names: Eric Barone with role first, GamesRadar bracketed. Sensitive: none (the marriage candidates are not mentioned). Footage-first: a game story on official game footage, not stills. | v2 12:35 Dubai: v1 sheet showed a black 'Start from nothing...' title card at 12.4 to 14.9 s (shots 0 and 1); stretch moved to 15.0 to 38.4 s. Audio split applied on v1 (music 43.9%, leak 0.5%). | v3 12:37 Dubai: v2 failed in autofocus (the Steam trailer is shorter than 38 s); stretch 15.0 to 33.0 s (v1 sheet showed clean frames up to 33.2 s), 8 shots of 2.25 s, three lines; GamesRadar named in the top credit line, in the X text and in the captions.
